053/**
054 * Abstract base class for mojos related to Docker files and builds.
055 *
056 * @author Álvaro Sánchez-Mariscal
057 * @author Iván López
058 * @since 1.1
059 */
060public abstract class AbstractDockerMojo extends AbstractMicronautMojo {
061
062    public static final String LATEST_TAG = "latest";
063    public static final String DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE_GRAALVM_RUN = "cgr.dev/chainguard/wolfi-base:latest";
064    public static final String MOSTLY_STATIC_NATIVE_IMAGE_GRAALVM_FLAG = "-H:+StaticExecutableWithDynamicLibC";
065    public static final String ARM_ARCH = "aarch64";
066    public static final String X86_64_ARCH = "x64";
067    public static final String ORACLE_CLOUD_FUNCTION_DEFAULT_CMD = "CMD [\"io.micronaut.oraclecloud.function.http.HttpFunction::handleRequest\"]";
068    public static final String GDS_DOWNLOAD_URL = "https://gds.oracle.com/download/graal/%s/latest-gftc/graalvm-jdk-%s_linux-%s_bin.tar.gz";
069    public static final String LAMBDA_BOOTSTRAP_DOCKER_COMMAND_PLACEHOLDER = "${LAMBDA_BOOTSTRAP_DOCKER_COMMAND}";
070    private static final String DEPENDENCY_DIRECTORY = "dependency";
071    private static final String RELEASE_DEPENDENCY_DIRECTORY = "release";
072    private static final String SNAPSHOT_DEPENDENCY_DIRECTORY = "snapshot";
073    private static final NavigableSet<Integer> GRAALVM_VERSIONS = new TreeSet<>(Set.of(25));
074    private static final List<String> DEFAULT_LAMBDA_BOOTSTRAP_ARGUMENTS = List.of(
075        "-XX:MaximumHeapSizePercent=80",
076        "-Dio.netty.allocator.numDirectArenas=0",
077        "-Dio.netty.noPreferDirect=true",
078        "-Djava.library.path=$(pwd)"
079    );

168    protected AbstractDockerMojo(MavenProject mavenProject, JibConfigurationService jibConfigurationService,
169                                 ApplicationConfigurationService applicationConfigurationService,
170                                 DockerService dockerService, MavenSession mavenSession, MojoExecution mojoExecution) {
171        this.mavenProject = mavenProject;
172        this.mavenSession = mavenSession;
173        this.jibConfigurationService = jibConfigurationService;
174        this.applicationConfigurationService = applicationConfigurationService;
175        this.dockerService = dockerService;
176        this.expressionEvaluator = new PluginParameterExpressionEvaluator(mavenSession, mojoExecution);
177    }
178
179    /**
180     * @return the Java version from either the <code>maven.compiler.target</code> property or the <code>java.version</code> property.
181     */
182    protected ArtifactVersion javaVersion() {
183        return new DefaultArtifactVersion(getJdkVersion());
184    }
185
186    private String getJdkVersion() {
187        var releaseVersion = getPropertyValue(mavenProject, "maven.compiler.release");
188        var targetVersion = getPropertyValue(mavenProject, "maven.compiler.target");
189        return releaseVersion.or(() -> targetVersion).orElseGet(() -> System.getProperty("java.version"));
190    }
191
192    private static Optional<String> getPropertyValue(MavenProject project, String propertName) {
193        var systemProperty = Optional.of(propertName).map(System::getProperty);
194        var properties = project.getProperties();
195        var projectProperty = Optional.of(propertName).map(properties::getProperty);
196        return systemProperty.or(() -> projectProperty);
197    }
198
199    /**
200     * @return the JVM version to use for GraalVM.
201     */
202    protected String graalVmJvmVersion() {
203        return Integer.toString(resolveGraalVersion());
204    }
205
206    /**
207     * @return the GraalVM download URL depending on the Java version.
208     */
209    protected String graalVmDownloadUrl() {
210        Integer version = resolveGraalVersion();
211
212        return GDS_DOWNLOAD_URL.formatted(version, version, graalVmArch());
213    }
214
215    private Integer resolveGraalVersion() {
216        int target = javaVersion().getMajorVersion();
217        Integer version = GRAALVM_VERSIONS.floor(target);
218
219        return version != null ? version : GRAALVM_VERSIONS.first();
220    }
221
222    /**
223     * @return the OS architecture to use for GraalVM depending on the <code>os.arch</code> system property.
224     */
225    protected String graalVmArch() {
226        return isArm() ? ARM_ARCH : X86_64_ARCH;
227    }
228
229    /**
230     * @return the base FROM image for the native image.
231     */
232    protected String getFrom() {
233        return getFromImage().orElse("ghcr.io/graalvm/native-image-community:" + graalVmTag(graalVmJvmVersion(), staticNativeImage, oracleLinuxVersion));
234    }
235
236    /**
237     * @param graalVmJvmVersion the JVM version string
238     * @param staticNativeImage whether to produce a static native image
239     * @param oracleLinuxVersion the Oracle Linux version to use
240     * @return the GraalVM Docker image tag based on the provided parameters
241     */
242    protected String graalVmTag(String graalVmJvmVersion, Boolean staticNativeImage, String oracleLinuxVersion) {
243        String suffix = Boolean.TRUE.equals(staticNativeImage)
244            ? "-muslib" + (StringUtils.hasText(oracleLinuxVersion) ? "-" + oracleLinuxVersion : "")
245            : (StringUtils.hasText(oracleLinuxVersion) ? "-" + oracleLinuxVersion : "");
246        return graalVmJvmVersion + suffix;
247    }
248
249    /**
250     * Check os.arch against known ARM architecture identifiers.
251     *
252     * @return true if we think we're running on an arm JDK
253     */
254    protected boolean isArm() {
255        return switch (System.getProperty("os.arch")) {
256            case ARM_ARCH, "arm64" -> true;
257            default -> false;
258        };
259    }

261    /**
262     * @return the base image from the jib configuration (if any).
263     */
264    protected Optional<String> getFromImage() {
265        return jibConfigurationService.getFromImage();
266    }
267
268    /**
269     * @return the Docker image tags by looking at the Jib plugin configuration.
270     */
271    protected Set<String> getTags() {
272        var tags = new HashSet<String>();
273        Optional<String> toImageOptional = jibConfigurationService.getToImage();
274        String imageName = mavenProject.getArtifactId();
275        if (toImageOptional.isPresent()) {
276            String toImage = toImageOptional.get();
277            if (toImage.contains(":")) {
278                tags.add(toImage);
279                imageName = toImageOptional.get().split(":")[0];
280            } else {
281                tags.add(toImage + ":" + LATEST_TAG);
282                imageName = toImage;
283            }
284        } else {
285            tags.add(imageName + ":" + LATEST_TAG);
286        }
287        for (String tag : jibConfigurationService.getTags()) {
288            if (LATEST_TAG.equals(tag) && tags.stream().anyMatch(t -> t.contains(LATEST_TAG))) {
289                continue;
290            }
291            tags.add(String.format("%s:%s", imageName, tag));
292        }
293        return tags.stream()
294            .map(this::evaluateExpression)
295            .collect(Collectors.toSet());
296    }
297
298    private String evaluateExpression(String expression) {
299        try {
300            return expressionEvaluator.evaluate(expression, String.class).toString();
301        } catch (Exception e) {
302            return expression;
303        }
304    }
305
306    /**
307     * @return the application ports to expose by looking at the Jib configuration or the application configuration.
308     */
309    protected String getPorts() {
310        return jibConfigurationService.getPorts().orElseGet(() -> {
311            String port = applicationConfigurationService.getServerPort();
312            return "-1".equals(port) ? DEFAULT_PORT : port;
313        });
314    }

316    /**
317     * Copy project dependencies to a <code>target/dependency</code> directory.
318     */
319    protected void copyDependencies() throws IOException {
320        var imageClasspathScopes = Arrays.asList(Artifact.SCOPE_COMPILE, Artifact.SCOPE_RUNTIME);
321        var target = new File(mavenProject.getBuild().getDirectory(), DEPENDENCY_DIRECTORY).toPath();
322        Files.createDirectories(target);
323        Files.createDirectories(target.resolve(RELEASE_DEPENDENCY_DIRECTORY));
324        Files.createDirectories(target.resolve(SNAPSHOT_DEPENDENCY_DIRECTORY));
325        for (Artifact dependency : mavenProject.getArtifacts()) {
326            if (!imageClasspathScopes.contains(dependency.getScope())) {
327                continue;
328            }
329            var dependencyFile = dependency.getFile().toPath();
330            var dependencyName = dependency.getFile().getName();
331            var layeredPath = target.resolve(dependencyLayerDirectory(dependency)).resolve(dependencyName);
332            Files.copy(dependencyFile, layeredPath, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
333            Files.copy(dependencyFile, target.resolve(dependencyName), StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
334        }
335    }
336
337    private static String dependencyLayerDirectory(Artifact dependency) {
338        return dependency.isSnapshot() ? SNAPSHOT_DEPENDENCY_DIRECTORY : RELEASE_DEPENDENCY_DIRECTORY;
339    }

341    /**
342     * @return the Docker CMD command.
343     */
344    protected String getCmd() {
345        return "CMD [" +
346            appArguments.stream()
347                .map(s -> "\"" + s + "\"")
348                .collect(Collectors.joining(", ")) +
349            "]";
350    }
351
352    /**
353     * @return the generated AWS Lambda bootstrap command.
354     */
355    protected String getLambdaBootstrapCommand() {
356        var command = new StringBuilder("./func");
357        for (String bootstrapArgument : DEFAULT_LAMBDA_BOOTSTRAP_ARGUMENTS) {
358            command.append(' ').append(bootstrapArgument);
359        }
360        if (lambdaBootstrapArguments != null && !lambdaBootstrapArguments.isEmpty()) {
361            for (String lambdaBootstrapArgument : lambdaBootstrapArguments) {
362                command.append(' ').append(escapeBootstrapArgument(lambdaBootstrapArgument));
363            }
364        }
365        return command.toString();
366    }
367
368    /**
369     * Applies the generated AWS Lambda bootstrap script to a dockerfile template.
370     *
371     * @param dockerfile the docker file
372     */
373    protected void lambdaBootstrapCommand(File dockerfile) throws IOException {
374        if (dockerfile == null) {
375            return;
376        }
377        if (lambdaBootstrapArguments != null && !lambdaBootstrapArguments.isEmpty()) {
378            getLog().info("Using AWS Lambda bootstrap arguments: " + lambdaBootstrapArguments);
379        }
380        var allLines = Files.readAllLines(dockerfile.toPath());
381        var result = new ArrayList<String>(allLines.size());
382        for (String line : allLines) {
383            if (line.contains(LAMBDA_BOOTSTRAP_DOCKER_COMMAND_PLACEHOLDER)) {
384                result.add(line.replace(LAMBDA_BOOTSTRAP_DOCKER_COMMAND_PLACEHOLDER, getLambdaBootstrapDockerCommand()));
385            } else {
386                result.add(line);
387            }
388        }
389        Files.write(dockerfile.toPath(), result);
390    }
391
392    private String getLambdaBootstrapDockerCommand() {
393        return "printf '%s\\n' "
394            + Stream.of("#!/bin/sh", "set -euo pipefail", getLambdaBootstrapCommand())
395            .map(AbstractDockerMojo::quoteShellLiteral)
396            .collect(Collectors.joining(" "))
397            + " > bootstrap";
398    }
399
400    private static String escapeBootstrapArgument(String argument) {
401        if (isShellSafe(argument)) {
402            return argument;
403        }
404        return quoteShellLiteral(argument);
405    }
406
407    private static boolean isShellSafe(String argument) {
408        if (argument == null || argument.isEmpty()) {
409            return false;
410        }
411        for (int i = 0; i < argument.length(); i++) {
412            char c = argument.charAt(i);
413            if (!Character.isLetterOrDigit(c)
414                && "_@%+=:,./-".indexOf(c) == -1) {
415                return false;
416            }
417        }
418        return true;
419    }
420
421    private static String quoteShellLiteral(String value) {
422        return "'" + value.replace("'", "'\"'\"'") + "'";
423    }

432    /**
433     * @return Map of proxy-related build arguments for Docker builds.
434     */
435    protected Map<String, String> getProxyBuildArgs() {
436        var proxyArgs = new java.util.HashMap<String, String>();
437        
438        // HTTP proxy configuration from standard JVM properties
439        String httpProxyHost = System.getProperty("http.proxyHost");
440        String httpProxyPort = System.getProperty("http.proxyPort", "80");
441        if (StringUtils.hasText(httpProxyHost)) {
442            String httpProxy = "http://" + httpProxyHost + ":" + httpProxyPort;
443            proxyArgs.put("HTTP_PROXY", httpProxy);
444            proxyArgs.put("http_proxy", httpProxy);
445        }
446        
447        // HTTPS proxy configuration from standard JVM properties
448        String httpsProxyHost = System.getProperty("https.proxyHost");
449        String httpsProxyPort = System.getProperty("https.proxyPort", "443");
450        if (StringUtils.hasText(httpsProxyHost)) {
451            String httpsProxy = "http://" + httpsProxyHost + ":" + httpsProxyPort;
452            proxyArgs.put("HTTPS_PROXY", httpsProxy);
453            proxyArgs.put("https_proxy", httpsProxy);
454        }
455        
456        // No proxy configuration from standard JVM properties
457        String nonProxyHosts = System.getProperty("http.nonProxyHosts");
458        if (StringUtils.hasText(nonProxyHosts)) {
459            // Convert Java format (e.g., "*.company.com|localhost") to standard format (e.g., "*.company.com,localhost")
460            String noProxy = nonProxyHosts.replace("|", ",");
461            proxyArgs.put("NO_PROXY", noProxy);
462            proxyArgs.put("no_proxy", noProxy);
463        }
464        
465        return proxyArgs;
466    }

468    /**
469     * @return the base image to use for the Dockerfile.
470     */
471    protected String getBaseImage() {
472        return JibMicronautExtension.determineBaseImage(JibMicronautExtension.getJdkVersion(mavenSession), MicronautRuntime.valueOf(micronautRuntime.toUpperCase()).getBuildStrategy());
473    }
474
475    /**
476     * Adds cmd to docker oracle cloud function file.
477     *
478     * @param dockerfile the docker file
479     */
480    protected void oracleCloudFunctionCmd(File dockerfile) throws IOException {
481        if (appArguments != null && !appArguments.isEmpty()) {
482            getLog().info("Using application arguments: " + appArguments);
483            com.google.common.io.Files.asCharSink(dockerfile, Charset.defaultCharset(), FileWriteMode.APPEND).write(System.lineSeparator() + getCmd());
484        } else {
485            com.google.common.io.Files.asCharSink(dockerfile, Charset.defaultCharset(), FileWriteMode.APPEND).write(System.lineSeparator() + ORACLE_CLOUD_FUNCTION_DEFAULT_CMD);
486        }
487    }
